title: MLConf 2026 - travel + expense scratchpad
content:
Quick scratchpad for MLConf (May 4-6, 2026) travel plan + expense reminders

Attendees: me (Asha), Samir, Lina (maybe join day 2)
Conference: MLConf 2026, Moscone West, San Francisco
Conference site / agenda: https://mlconf.org/2026/agenda

Flight (booked on corporate card)
- UA 1872, SFO -> SFO (direct?) — actually booked SFO->SFO is wrong (typo) -> UA 1872 from SEA->SFO on 2026-05-03 13:10 ARR 15:05 (confirm)
- Booking ref: HJ4K9Z (Concur link attached in expense request)
- Checked baggage: 1 free (corporate policy) -> keep receipt for any extra bag fees
- Note: change leg? Samir might arrive earlier (he's connecting from BOS). Confirm gate/time 24hrs prior.

Hotel (group rate)
- Hotel: The Moscone Grand (placeholder name) — group code REDWOOD_MLC
- Address: 745 Howard St, San Francisco, CA 94103 (confirm against confirmation email)
- Check-in: 2026-05-03 after 3pm, Check-out: 2026-05-07 11am
- Reservation under: Asha Patel (Corp card prepay). Confirmation: 983-MLC-RED
- Vendor contact: Reservations +1 (415) 555-0123, events@mosconehotel.com
- Note: request late checkout if flights delayed on 5/7; mention corp rate on checkout to avoid incidental charges to personal card.

Ground transport
- Airport -> hotel: Lyft (use company Lyft Business) OR hotel shuttle if available (confirm times).
- Estimated cost: $30-50 each way. Save receipts, include trip ID in expense.
- Shuttle vendor: Moscone Shuttle +1 (415) 555-0456 (runs 5:30am-11:30pm)

Per-diem and meals
- Company policy: meals reimbursed up to $75/day domestic travel (confirm policy in Concur/People Ops).
- On-site client dinners: flagged as "entertainment" -> need guest names + reason for business meal.

Expense categories / GL codes to use (put in Concur line items)
- Airfare: TRV-AIR
- Hotel: LODG-CORP
- Ground: TRV-TRANS
- Meals: TRV-MEAL
- Incidentals / parking: TRV-OTHER
(Confirm exact code prefixes with finance before submitting)

Receipts & submission notes
- Scan all receipts and attach PDF to Concur within 14 days of travel end date.
- For hotel folio: request itemized folio at checkout (separate out mini-bar / incidentals).
- If paid on personal card, add "Paid by Asha Patel personal card" and attach reimbursement form + bank last 4 digits.
- For Lyft: get receipt email and Concur trip ID.

Vendor contacts (quick)
- Hotel reservations: events@mosconehotel.com | +1 (415) 555-0123
- Hotel events manager (if needed): Maria Chen | maria.chen@mosconehotel.com
- Shuttle operator: Moscone Shuttle | +1 (415) 555-0456
- Local AV vendor (for booth): BayAV Solutions | av@bayav.io | +1 (415) 555-0789
- Catering contact (if team lunch): GoodBite Catering | sales@goodbiteco.com | +1 (415) 555-0345

Conference logistics notes
- Booth: 3x3 island, setup window 5/3 4pm-8pm (confirm with events manager). Bring table runner + monitor mount + backup USB-C hub.
- Shipping: FedEx to hotel receiving (hold for guest name) — confirm hotel receiving policy and fees. If fees charged, get receipt to bill to project.
- Promo swag: 400 stickers, 100 postcards, 50 hoodies (hoodies paid by marketing budget) -> track receipts under PRO-MKT tag.
- Demo laptop: MacBook Pro (work) + dongles + 2x power bricks. Make sure the laptop is encrypted (company policy).

Reimbursement and approval flows
- Submit expenses in Concur, tag project "MLCONF-2026". Samir to approve if he is TL on this budget; otherwise Lina.
- For any expense > $500, need pre-approval email thread attached. Save approval thread PDF.

To-do (before travel)
- [ ] Confirm final headcount and travel dates with Lina (due 2026-03-15)
- [ ] Confirm hotel late checkout option and shuttle schedule (Asha)
- [ ] Verify GL codes with Finance (Samir)
- [ ] Upload flight + hotel receipts to Concur and create draft expense report (Asha)
- [ ] Request booth setup details and AV contact (Samir)
- [ ] Print shipping labels for swag and coordinate with marketing ops (Lina)
- [ ] Add meetings to calendar + book 30-min prep slot before booth opening (All)

Notes to self / unresolved questions
- Double-check corporate card covers incidental charges at hotel (some hotels put hold that may block card temporarily). If hold > $250, use personal card and submit for reimbursement? Ask finance.
- Should we book refundable fares for Samir? He might extend stay. If refundable premium is >$150 diff, weigh against potential change fee.
- If Lina joins day 2 only, check if she should book separate flight/expense or use same PNR. Simpler to book separately.

Quick expense reminder checklist for reporting (post-conference)
- Attach receipts for every line-item (single PDF per trip recommended).
- Itemize hotel folio and mark any personal charges.
- Add attendee list + business purpose for any meal > $75.
- Keep currency conversions (if any) with card statement screenshot.

Last-minute contact list (saved to phone)
- Samir Rao (mobile): +1 (415) 555-1010
- Lina Gomez (mobile): +1 (917) 555-2020
- Asha (me): mobile on file

Misc notes (brainstorm/fragments)
- Consider partial remote presence for Lina if travel budgets tighten.
- Follow up with marketing on swag count — confirm final ship date by 4/10.
- Post-mortem template: what went well / what to improve (logistics, demo reliability, swag usage, lead capture).

End of scratchpad. Will tidy into formal Concur expense checklist + calendar invites later.
